name: Sip (Automatic indoor basil hydration sensor )
tagline: Autonomous plant hydration system with moisture telemetry
summary: Custom build tailored from idea: "Automatic indoor basil hydration sensor dcq6sdak1af". Sip continuously monitors soil moisture via an analog capacitive sensor probe. When the moisture drops below 35%, it engages a 5V relay driving a submersible DC water pump for 3 seconds, displays moisture and status on an I2C OLED screen, and reports telemetry over serial.

parts.name: Arduino Uno R3
parts.why: Central ATmega328P controller running realtime moisture threshold control logic.

parts.name: Capacitive Soil Moisture Sensor
parts.why: Corrosion-resistant analog soil humidity measurement probe.

parts.name: 5V Single Channel Relay Module
parts.why: Optocoupled 5V relay safely switching 5V/12V submersible water pump current.

parts.name: 0.96 inch I2C OLED Display
parts.why: 128x64 high contrast display showing real-time moisture % and pump status.

parts.name: 18650 Li-ion Battery Holder with DC Jack
parts.why: Powers Arduino VIN and water pump via standard DC barrel connector.

product.pageHeadline: Never let your monstera or basil dry out again.
bullets: Precision capacitive soil moisture telemetry prevents over- or under-watering
Isolated 5V relay drive supports standard submersible 5V/12V DC water pumps
Integrated 0.96-inch OLED displays live hydration metrics and watering timestamps
Snap-fit desktop enclosure with custom cutouts for power and probe routing

buildSteps: Step 1: 3D print the enclosure base and snap-fit lid with 20% infill and 2.0mm wall thickness.
Step 2: Mount the Arduino Uno R3 onto the M3 standoffs using nylon screws.
Step 3: Secure the 5V relay module and wire VCC/GND/IN to 5V/GND/D7.
Step 4: Connect the I2C OLED display lines (SDA to A4, SCL to A5).
Step 5: Route the capacitive soil moisture probe harness through the side gland slot to pin A0.
Step 6: Power on via 18650 battery holder or DC barrel jack, calibrate soil moisture thresholds, and verify live pump switching.
